name: Neo (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Neo village emblem in green: a disc bearing white stylised characters, with a pointed stroke at the hoist.
history: Flag of the former village of Neo in Gifu Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-02-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 June 1978.

features.role: Neo village emblem — a disc bearing white stylised characters, with a pointed stroke at the hoist
